name: Shin'en no Hanayome
source:
Ayana was a lonely girl who lived in a fishing village.

One day, due to a long-lasting poor catch, she was sent as a sacrifice to another village, surrounded by rumors.

Will she marry the village chief, Ether or run away?

Her fate will be decided by the actions you take within the next three days!

[Edited from [url=https://tohko.itch.io/bride-of-the-abyss]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿亚娜是一个住在渔村的孤独女孩。

有一天，由于长期捕捞不佳，她被送到另一个村庄作为祭品，周围充满了谣言。

她会嫁给村长艾瑟还是逃跑？

她的命运将取决于你三天内的行动！

[编辑自[url=https://tohko.itch.io/bride-of-the-abyss]itch.io[/url]]
